title: Player club filter works but FIFA dataset has no Brazilian-club players
evidence: lib/soccer_mcp/query.ex:262 players/2 filters by club substring correctly; README.md notes fifa_data.csv contains no Flamengo/Brazilian-club rows, so those club searches return empty — a data limitation, not a code defect
suggestion: None required; limitation is documented honestly in README

title: venue_ranking does not disambiguate same-named clubs
evidence: lib/soccer_mcp/query.ex:239 venue_ranking groups by home_key/away_key only; README.md states standings separate same-named clubs by state but venue rankings do not yet
suggestion: Include state in the venue_ranking grouping key for full consistency with standings

title: Copa do Brasil final labeling is inferred, not from data
evidence: lib/soccer_mcp/store.ex:149 mark_cup_finals treats the last numbered round with <=2 matches as the final; no finals labeled for 2021 (group-style last round)
suggestion: None required; inference is reasonable and documented
